title: Essentals
description: just some essential mods for minecraft to improve your experiance :3
body:
This modpack adds things to improve your game, while keeping it simple and vanilla. This inclides:
- Simple Voice Chat
- Essential
- Carpet
- Dynamainc Lights
- Dynamanic FPS
- AppleSkin
- 3D Skin Layers
- Sodium
- Lithium
- Mouse Tweaks
- And more!
